resolution.note: freeze.ts hashes the scorer's transitive local import closure; manifest re-frozen; test asserts boundaries.ts is hashed

title: Hash every file the FR-40 scorer imports in the frozen manifest
body:
The frozen FR-40 manifest (evals/fr40/manifest.json) hashes scorers.ts, but scorers.ts imports scripts/boundaries.ts (core-imports scorer), which lives outside the experiment directory and is not hashed: a boundaries.ts change silently changes the core-imports verdicts after freeze.
Acceptance: either the scorer vendors the boundary check inside evals/fr40, or test/evals/fr40-report.test.ts fails when any file the scorer imports changes without a re-freeze (freeze.ts --check reports drift).
